summary_1line: Spy Shardula reports Rama’s massive monkey army and his capture and release, but Ravana refuses to return Sita and asks for details of the enemy leaders.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bloodied and exhausted, the captured spy Shardula is dragged through ranks of towering monkeys and brought before Rama, who raises his hand and commands them to stop.
Across the sea near Mount Suvela, Rama stands surrounded by a vast army of monkeys arranged in the shape of Garuda, preparing to advance on Lanka.
In his golden court of Lanka, Ravana listens sternly to the trembling spy while declaring he would never return Sita even if the whole world opposed him.
